craft_notes: Sthāyin: the shakes (five-action list: shake-tremble-quake-shudder-power — the body's OWN yoga, not imposed). Sanskrit: kampate kampate...calana...ākampana...śaktir jvalati...niścalā...sarvaśaktisvabhāvaḥ → L4 keeps four-shake line 1, non-tiring power-line 2. Rows: row 2 (ceasing→own-condition). Close: own-condition (svabhāva — power's NATURE, not achievement: the shake is what power does unceasingly). Rejected: 'earthquake' theatre — killed: four-shakes kept graded (the distinctions between kamp/calān/ākamp are real); 'energy surges' — killed: non-tiring kept (the tiredness-refusal is the verse).

l4.sanskrit_cite: vastvantare vedyamāne sarvavastuṣu śūnyatā | tām eva manasā dhyātvā vidito 'pi praśāmyati

reads_against.argmap: What calms when voidness is meditated? → Meditating voidness in all things, even known-ness becomes calm.
c1_essence: Voidness meditated in all things: even knowing calms.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra with śānta undertow (resolve laid quiet)
